mechanism_narrative: The persistently low federal funds rate of 0.18% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This is a general pattern observed in low-rate environments.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.0%, the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days, reflecting weak labor market conditions that suppress equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (<=0.5%) and low CPI (<=220) compresses discount rates and reduces inflation risk, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% AND CPIAUCSL <= 220.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (defined by FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and rising > 0.2% in 3 months), the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased risk aversion.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS rising > 0.2% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS rising > 0.2% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 550.0 thousand units, the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days, reflecting weak consumer demand and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 550.0.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low housing starts (<550.0) and low retail sales (<360000 million dollars) indicates weak consumer demand, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 550.0 AND RSAFS < 360000.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 92.5, the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting a contraction in the supply of goods and services that suppresses corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 92.5.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth falls below 130000 thousand persons, the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days, reflecting a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending power and equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS < 130000.
